description: This file defines a singleton object 'WakeWords' which manages a list of wake words, including parsing, sanitization, and validation functions.

methods.name: parseCommaSeparated
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string into a list of trimmed, non-empty strings.

methods.name: parseIfChanged
methods.description: Parses input and compares it with the current list, returning a new list only if changed.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Cleans up the list of words by trimming, filtering out empty entries, limiting size and length, or returning default if resulting list is empty.
